votes.motion: Close the public hearing on RDA Budget Amendment No. 2 for Fiscal Year 2022-23
votes.description: Closes the public hearing held to receive comment on the proposed amendment to the RDA's FY2022-23 budget, which included a gap loan for the Spark! project, Station Center contract funding, and compensation adjustments.

votes.motion: Approve the minutes from May 18, 2021; June 1, 2021; May 3, 2022; May 17, 2022; June 7, 2022; June 14, 2022; August 9, 2022 and September 13, 2022
votes.description: Approves multiple sets of prior RDA Board meeting minutes spanning from May 2021 through September 2022.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 18 of 2022, amending the final budget of the RDA for Fiscal Year 2022-2023
votes.description: Adopts the RDA Budget Amendment No. 2 for FY2022-23, including a $4 million gap loan for the Spark! project, $500,000 for the Station Center Vision Plan contract, salary adjustments, and return of $1 million from the Marmalade Plaza Project.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 17 of 2022 Spark! Project Gap Loan
votes.description: Approves the term sheet for a $4,000,000 gap loan to Brinshore Development, L.L.C. for construction of a mixed-use, affordable housing project at approximately 1500 West North Temple in the North Temple Project Area.

votes.motion: Adopt the amendments to the Resolution (Spark! Project Gap Loan)
votes.description: Adopts amendments to Resolution 17 of 2022, including changing the word 'minimum' to 'maximum' in the affordability restrictions of the loan terms for the Spark! Project.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 19 of 2022 regarding electronic meetings
votes.description: Adopts a resolution governing how a quorum is calculated during electronic meetings when one or more Board members participate remotely, as required by state law changes to the Open and Public Meetings Act.

votes.motion: Enter into Closed Session for discussion of character/competence of an individual, collective bargaining strategy, pending litigation, purchase/exchange/lease of real property, sale of real property, deployment of security personnel, investigative proceedings regarding criminal misconduct, and attorney-client privileged matters
votes.description: Moves the Board into a closed session covering multiple permissible topics under the Utah Open and Public Meetings Act, including litigation strategy and real property transactions.
Moves the Board to conclude the closed session and return to open session.
